id: title:fasyy612:hide translator extension popup injected into recorded pages

review.posthog_relevance: Replay system configuration and browser compatibility
review.reason: Adds a CSS rule to hide specific elements ('translate-tooltip-mtz', 'translate-button-mtz') from recording, potentially preserving visual fidelity in PostHog's replay system. This is a configuration change rather than a complete implementation.
review.uncertainty: This chunk lacks the complete implementation and consumer-side changes, making it impossible to verify compatibility or actual application. The score is assigned based on the observable configuration addition, not the verified outcome.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation or configuration of the shared replay library. The hunk P1.F2.H1 adds a CSS rule and an array entry, but without the corresponding consumer-side changes or the complete shared library context, it is impossible to determine if this configuration is actually applied, tested, or compatible with the rest of PostHog's replay system

observations.behavior: Adds a CSS rule to hide elements matching selectors 'body > div.translate-tooltip-mtz' and 'body > span.translate-button-mtz' and appends this rule to the shared replayer configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a browser extension's popup from being recorded and displayed in the replay, potentially preserving the visual fidelity of the recorded page. However, this hunk is a test, not the implementation, and the implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 is present but lacks surrounding context to verify compatibility.
